Messages.Body:
On VTES-L, VampChamp1 <VampC...@AOL.COM> wrote:
> Fractured Armament: Can this and other cards be played to destroy equipment if
> there isn't any?

Yes.

Subject: Rules Team Rulings: 2/21/96
Date: 21 Feb 1996 21:48:14 GMT
Message-ID: <4gg3uu$9...@darkstar.UCSC.EDU>

Q: Can you attempt to steal or destroy equipment if your opponent has none?
A: Yes; in this case, your strike is simply ineffective. However, if you
play such a strike, you must steal or destroy equipment if possible; you
cannot ignore a piece of equipment you'd rather your opponent kept.

> If it can, does it still do the damage?

Yes, the effects are independent of each other.
